prompt: What can someone who leaves the arch at eleven thirty do before noon?
promptZh: 十一點半離開拱門後，到中午前可以做什麼？

options.text: Remain at the arch to finish drawing without the guide.
options.zh: 不跟導覽員走，留在拱門畫完。
options.whyZh: 十一點半所有人都要離開拱門。

options.text: Finish a drawing at the shelter without having to walk back with the guide.
options.zh: 自行走回遮棚把畫完成，不必跟導覽員走。
options.whyZh: 遮棚開到中午，且同行只是選擇，不是規定。

options.text: Borrow a board and carry it back to the arch.
options.zh: 借畫板，再帶回拱門使用。
options.whyZh: 畫板要留在遮棚，拱門也已到離開時間。

options.text: Ask the guide to keep the arch open until noon.
options.zh: 請導覽員讓拱門開放到中午。
options.whyZh: 開到中午的地點是遮棚，不是拱門。

explanationZh: 遮棚開到中午，且同行只是選擇，不是規定。
evidence: The guide will ask everyone to leave the arch at eleven thirty. / If you want to finish a drawing after that, return to the shelter and use one of the tables. / We will leave the shelter open until noon as usual; there is no need to walk back with the guide unless you want company.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The guide will ask everyone to leave the arch at eleven thirty.
If you want to finish a drawing after that, return to the shelter and use one of the tables.
We will leave the shelter open until noon as usual; there is no need to walk back with the guide unless you want company.

vocabulary.note: 此處表示可自由返程，只有想找人作伴才需考慮隨導覽員走。
